title: Show each pane's and session's memory from its systemd scope
notes:
Part 4 of 4 (optional, after parts 1-3): show each pane's and session's memory.

Read memory.current of the recorded scope (/sys/fs/cgroup/user.slice/user-<uid>.slice/user@<uid>.service/agents.slice/<unit>/memory.current) every few seconds, only for open projects, and show it in the manager's pane list and the status bar (e.g. '2.1G'), with a mark near the per-scope MemoryHigh. Nothing shown when no scope is recorded. Reading is cheap: one small file per scope.
Tests: the formatting and threshold decisions pure with tests. Docs: docs/processes, manager README, help blurb if the list gains a column (keys-rule-2).
